en: Urgh... Too much...breakfast...

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway... It seems like everyone
wants to do their own thing...

<CLT=cltMIND>What can we do to work better
together as a group?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I could do something on my own,
but that's impossible...

<CLT=cltMIND>If I screw up, it'll be just
like Kaede all over again—

...I did it again.
I can't keep these thoughts out of my head!

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't stand around doing nothing!
I...promised her!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why all the uniforms...?
They could at least give me some casual clothes.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND> is on here...

<CLT=cltMIND>We promised not to tell each other
who has whose <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltMIND>.
